memoryRule: a wheel turn removes one actual pigment rung, leaves a load-bearing gap, makes later rungs sag, and suspends the missing load as a counterweight
interactionRule: wheel, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Enter, Space, and the turn control commit one bounded ordinal turn; lifting the latest restores the exact prior register
representationRupture: surface, pressure plate, island field, and membrane -> discrete hanging pigment register
encounterRupture: draw, approach, or departure -> wheel/keyboard step with no pointer-position state
temporalRupture: continuous surface deformation -> ordinal removal followed by settling and accumulated counterweights
promotion: candidate / held pending independent caption-free perceptual review, production verification, and provider revision linkage
